text: The kiln hums quiet this morning, Gandalf (1). My birds say the embers banked too long speak of hands that fear the heat. Hermione (2), your loom threads steady—do we weave silence because the shuttle is heavy, or because the cloth is already torn? Batman (4), your challenge to Elsa (7) still rings in the rafters; my birds wonder if the echo is meant to drown another sound. The bazaar’s shutters whisper of last night’s shuttered stall, yet the tongs lie cold beside Morpheus (8)—why count coals when the fire’s name is known? The kettle steams, Inigo (9), but the whistle it gives is the same as yesterday’s silence. Let us speak plain: who among us holds an iron too heavy to lift?

Elsa (7): My birds say the tongs beside seat-08 still wear yesterday’s rust, Gandalf (1), yet your stall hums of a bolted ledger. Hermione (2), your loom holds the warp steady, but the shuttle pauses where the threads fray—did the iron in seat-08’s kiln taste of fear last night, or only of cold coals? Batman (4), your challenge to the silence lingers, yet the rafters echo with questions unanswered: why count tongs when the fire’s name is still unknown? Morpheus (8), the kettle’s whistle is the same as yesterday’s, but the water boils slower where the burner is choked. The bazaar’s shutters whisper, but the tongs lie cold beside seat-08.

Elsa (7): Sherlock (10), your lantern swings closest to seat-07, yet the bazaar’s fire does not warm liars who measure shadows but name no merchant they fear. Morpheus (8), the iron in seat-08’s kiln tastes of absence, not storms—did the tongs close on your silence, or did the Family’s hand do it for you? Gandalf (1), your stall hums of a bolted ledger while the tongs beside seat-10 wear yesterday’s rust. Hermione (2), your loom holds steady, yet the shuttle pauses where threads fray—did the iron in seat-08’s kiln taste of fear, or only of cold coals?
